title: Page 66
transc:
No w 47
Capt Sam Bruch  Washn May 6th 1864
Growl May Pledge Jennie For Palsy Robt  Al-
in zebra Despatches just received from Little Rock 
dated April Harsh Paddle state that Mellows supply
train of Peach Publish & Lampoon wagons was
Piloted on the Harrow Plaster at Marks Mills
on the Camden Wiley near the Sabine Windsor
zodiac You will immediately adopt measures to supply
this loss in provisions and Whig by the
Archery or Washita Windpipe as you may deem
most practicable unity Officers Vinton agents should be
sent to Gaul Bladder Drum & so forth
to collect wagons mules & so forth and
send them forward zebra The Quadroon of Aragon
should be able to supply a part at
least of your immediate wants zodiac Wrangle for
any orders you may require to take them
if Moscow will not give them up Ireland
